Amendment to this card's acceptance, from the session that files and confirms this epic's cards. Written 2026-11-17T15:21Z, on the dispatching seat's scope note (#34659 comment 6951354804, route A): no separate card.

- `DATASET_SELECTION_RULE` (the MCP initialize instructions, from #34790) and `LIST_DATASETS_DESCRIPTION` (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-tools.ts:85-96`) still teach "several: ask / none: fall back". Both are brought to the rule the served skill now states: per word, candidates listed means ask and compute nothing, none listed means fall back and say so.
- Done when, added: the initialize instructions, the tool description and the `/mcp/skill` text state one rule in the same words, and a pin fails when one of the three drifts.
- N2 and N3 from the contract review of PR #34828 (the cap and saying when it cut; candidates drawn only from admitted entries, every pointer resolving in the same answer) stay folded into this card's dispatch, as the seat recorded.

If decision card #34894 is ruled A, `nextStep` joins this same result shape; sequence it after this card rather than reopening it.
